scope.summary: BkGenitals integration test (spec 13.21 acceptance; REQ-030/031/035, PREQ-011/019): archetypes (f) muscular and (g) slender male run the oversized-cock erection sweep end to end, archetype (a) runs the vulva gape range with penetration smoke test, archetype (h) futa validates decoupled, and Argus visual QA captures persist as CAP- evidence rows.
acceptance_criteria: Archetypes (f) and (g) with oversized penis: erection sweep flaccid to erect at oversized channel extremes passes mesh-quality and corrective gates end to end.
Archetype (a): vulva gape range closed to extreme gape passes manifold/collapse gates; canal depth plus penetration-corrective smoke test runs at documented penetrator sizes.
Archetype (h) futa smoke test: the mixed-anatomy config validates decoupled (BODY_DECOUPLE_VALID) and watertight.
Argus capture set per archetype (flaccid/semi/erect; closed/mid/extreme gape) persisted as CAP- evidence rows for validator and operator review.
scope.risk_if_missed: Without the archetype-level integration proof with captures, the genital module ships as unverified parts; the erection sweep and gape range on named acceptance archetypes are the contractual validation surface for the entire group.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

required_changes_before_execution: Gate genital integration on the detailed vulva, penis/scrotum, and deformation/contact/reference matrices.
